description: Exercise an API surface with Comber: an OpenAPI spec, a GraphQL endpoint, or a recorded HAR. Reports contract drift, error responses, and broken operations. Read-only by default.

allowPrivateTarget.description: Target a private/staging base you own (bypasses the SSRF egress guard).

apiBase.description: Base URL for the API (required with --openapi).

graphql.description: GraphQL endpoint URL to introspect + exercise.

har.description: Path to a recorded HAR to replay and check for drift.

openapi.description: Path or URL to an OpenAPI document.

strict.description: Return a failing summary if any 'fail' finding is present.

name: comber_api_check
title: comber check (API)
